Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Compact Photo Upload Step Redesign: Redesigns the photo upload screen using a compact layout with intuitive drop zone and instant verification components. (why: Custom photo adoption has long wait times and drop-offs (69.5% completion rate), plus 3 support emails reported photo pet creation issues.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Companion Trait Selection Flow: Adds personality trait checklist components directly into the pet selection screen prior to adoption confirmation. (why: Enhances emotional attachment early during the adoption step where 30.5% of users currently drop off.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post Adoption Certificate Sign In Reorder: Moves account sign-in to appear after the adoption certificate screen instead of before pet selection. (why: Allows users to pick and customize their pet before committing to account creation, reducing early sign-in friction.)
3: [home, new_screen] Desktop Overlay Readiness Check Screen: Introduces a new screen during generation that tests and confirms desktop overlay permissions before pet spawn. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets failing to appear on the desktop or the app stalling upon opening.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Existing Account Pet Sync Hint: Displays a explicit hint explaining that signing into an existing account restores all previously adopted desktop pets. (why: 8 support emails (the #1 support topic) reported pets missing or reset after signing back in.)
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Creation Render Progress Activity Stream: Adds dynamic progress status text showing detailed generation steps while waiting for pet creation. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s); detailed status feedback keeps users engaged during generation.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Companion Creation Path Clarity Copy: Updates body text on choose_path screen to explicitly differentiate quick ready-made companion vs custom creation. (why: Path selection copy tweaks have historically produced strong winning changes and clear path expectations reduce early drop-off.)
7: [home, notification] Pet Completion System Notification Alert: Enables desktop readiness notification alerts while pet generation completes in the background. (why: Long mean waiting times (2336s) cause users to abandon desktop app focus before onboarding finishes.)
8: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Incentive: Adds an official verification badge component to the adoption certificate screen to celebrate pet registration. (why: Adoption step has a 69.5% completion rate; visual rewards increase completion momentum into the final steps.)
9: [finish, redesign] Full Bleed Desktop Arrival Redesign: Redesigns home_intro to a full_bleed layout with clear instructions on desktop interaction controls. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or interact with pet.)
